title: EURA remains active after the agEUR rebrand
description: Angle Protocol continues to operate the euro stablecoin under the EURA name with protocol redemption and collateral modules.
notes: agEUR is retained as an alias rather than a separate asset.

title: EURCV remains active as a MiCA e-money token
description: Current SG-FORGE materials describe EURCV as a MiCA-compliant euro electronic-money token with segregated cash reserves and issuer redemption.
notes: Current regulatory and reserve status review.

title: EURI remains actively issued by Banking Circle
description: Eurite EURI remains active with one-to-one euro cash backing, MiCA treatment, and issuer redemption subject to due diligence.

title: EURQ remains active under Quantoz Payments
description: Current Quantoz materials describe EURQ as a euro e-money token backed by bank balances and government securities with redemption at par.

title: VCHF remains active as a Swiss-franc-referencing token
description: VNX continues to present VCHF as an active multichain Swiss-franc-referencing token available through issuer exchange routes.
notes: Reserve composition remains a known unknown.

title: SG-FORGE launches EUR CoinVertible
description: Societe Generale-FORGE announced the launch of EUR CoinVertible on April 20, 2023. Later regulatory elevation, reserve disclosures, and distribution changes remain separate lifecycle records.
notes: Official SG-FORGE launch release; added in Launch-date Batch O.

title: Banking Circle launches EURI
description: Banking Circle announced the launch of Eurite EURI on August 26, 2024 as a bank-backed MiCA-compliant euro e-money token.
notes: Official Banking Circle launch announcement; added in Launch-date Batch O.

title: Quantoz begins issuing EURQ
description: Quantoz Payments states that it began issuing EURQ and USDQ on November 18, 2024. Later exchange listings are treated as distribution events rather than the canonical launch.
notes: Official Quantoz issuance-start statement; added in Launch-date Batch O.

title: Angle launches agEUR on Ethereum mainnet
description: Angle Protocol announced its Ethereum mainnet launch on November 3, 2021 with agEUR as the protocol euro stablecoin. SOG uses this day as the canonical launch of the continuous asset now branded EURA.
notes: The later EURA name does not create a new asset identity.

title: agEUR is rebranded as EURA
description: Angle Protocol renamed agEUR to EURA on March 14, 2024 after a governance vote. The official announcement states that the existing token address remained unchanged and no separate token was introduced.
notes: Identity continuity is explicit: agEUR remains a historical alias of EURA.
